title: Donnagama #17 Wood Firing
source_quote:
Donnagama #17 Wood Firing
May 1-4, 2026
Onsite at New Prospect Pottery
Schedule:
- Fri, April 24: begin staging and loading
- Sat, April 25-Sun, April 26: continue loading
- Fri, May 1: preheat
- Sat, May 2 through May 4: fire kiln
- Sat, May 9: unload
evidence_sentence: The events page lists Donnagama #17 wood firing scheduled for May 1-4, 2026, with full loading and unload schedule.
summary: Join the wood firing of the Anagama Donnagama kiln from April 24 through May 9, 2026; contact the studio to reserve space and participate in loading, firing, and unloading.
how_to_join: Contact the studio to take part
commitment: Fri, April 24 load · Fri, May 1–Mon, May 4 fire · Sat, May 9 unload
